_comment: BeamHash III control pin (founder's decision-6, 10 Oct 2026): the published reference implementation from Beam's own repository, pinned by release tag and blob sha before any code is used. It is a measured architectural control (nonce-dependent intermediate memory, compact 104-byte solutions), never a candidate and never relabelled.

upstream.licence: Apache License, Version 2.0 (upstream LICENSE copied beside the sources)
upstream.fetched_by: raw.githubusercontent.com at the tag; blob shas from the GitHub contents API at the tag

algorithm.name: BeamHash III
algorithm.scheme_class: BeamHash_III (3rdparty/crypto/beamHashIII.h), selected past fork 2 by pow/beamHash.cpp getCurrentPoW
algorithm.base_state: blake2b personalised by InitialiseState, then H(input || nonce) where input is the block's hash-for-PoW (32 bytes)

known_answer.status: PENDING: the upstream tree carries no BeamHash III known-answer vector (pow/unittests/equihash_test.cpp is a solve-then-verify round trip); a mainnet block past fork 2 (hash-for-PoW, nonce, 104 solution bytes, difficulty) is the upstream known answer once an explorer answers; until then only the round trip of the pinned solver through the pinned verifier stands, and the row says so

gpu_solver.status: NONE OPEN: Beam's opencl-miner implements BeamHash I and II only; every BeamHash III GPU solver is a closed binary (lolMiner, gminer, miniZ). Nothing closed is used without main's word; the pinned CPU OptimisedSolve is the measured implementation until then

vendored: no: fetched on the build box by pow/third_party/fetch.sh beamhash3-7.5.14493 into src/ and verified by blob sha1 against FETCH; only FETCH, LICENSE and this lock live in the tree
